verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe escalation policies as custom rulesets defining who is alerted and in what order, continuing until acknowledged, with real examples (on-call person notified first, escalates to whole team after 3 minutes if unacknowledged), configurable complex rules based on time/team availability/incident origin, multi-region schedules, and phone/press-1 acknowledgment flows. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on third-party corroboration of escalation behavior beyond vendor docs.
